layout_summary: A parody poster layout on a pure white background featuring a glossy red stiletto with a trident heel dipping into an open spread jar on the left, balanced by a stacked serif title lockup on the right. A single-line bold red sans-serif tagline spans the bottom edge.

alignment_axes: DEVIL and BISCOFF share a left edge at x=46–46.5%
DEVIL and BISCOFF share a right edge near x=89.5–91%
Bottom tagline is horizontally centered at x=50%
whitespace: 10% horizontal gap between heel/jar (x=36%) and title block (x=46%)
37% open white space below title block (y=55.5% to y=92.5%)
10% empty band between jar base (y=82.5%) and bottom tagline (y=92.5%)

scene.subject: A glossy red stiletto heel with a three-pronged trident tip dipping into an open glass jar of smooth caramelized biscuit spread, with thick spread overflowing and dripping down the right side.
scene.composition: Positioned in the left third; the shoe enters cropped from the left edge and angles upward, descending vertically into the jar resting at the lower left.
scene.camera: Eye-level studio shot, sharp focus throughout.
scene.lighting: Bright, soft studio lighting with crisp specular highlights on the red patent shoe and a soft cast shadow beneath the jar.
negative_space: x=36% to 100%, y=0% to 92.5% (right side and upper-right)

elements.text: Don't be silly Andrea, everybody wants this.

ornaments.description: Black pointed devil-tail arrow extending upward from the right stroke of the letter V in DEVIL

why_it_works: Instant pop-culture parody recognition using the iconic red heel, serif lockup, and white-space ratio.
High-contrast red and black palette ties the shoe, jar label, and typography together cleanly.
Generous white space keeps the focus squarely on the visual pun and punchline.
